cd /home/agent/workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import sqlite3, os

files = lambda: [f for f in ('inventory.db-wal', 'inventory.db-shm') if os.path.exists(f)]

print("before any connection:", files() or "no sidecars")
conn = sqlite3.connect('inventory.db')
print("mode seen by new connection:", conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode").fetchone()[0])
print("while connection is open :", files() or "no sidecars")
conn.close()
print("after clean close        :", files() or "no sidecars")
print()
print("WAL sidecars exist only while a connection holds the DB open;")
print("on the last clean close SQLite checkpoints the WAL into the main")
print("file and deletes the sidecars. journal_mode=wal persists in the")
print("file header (confirmed above), so this is normal, not an anomaly.")
EOF
description: Demonstrate WAL sidecars are transient across connection lifecycle
